guidePage.title: Tax Guide
guidePage.description: Guides and resources for managing your tax obligations
guidePage.howToDeclarationDesc: Step-by-step guide to complete your tax declaration
guidePage.step1Desc: Collect all necessary documents: income statements, invoices, payment receipts.
guidePage.step1Tip1: Keep your documents organized by category
guidePage.step1Tip2: Make sure all amounts are legible
guidePage.step1Action1: Create an account on the platform
guidePage.step1Action2: Update profile and fill in personal information
guidePage.step2Desc: Use our calculator to estimate the amount of taxes to declare.
guidePage.step2Tip1: Use the calculator on the Calculator page
guidePage.step2Action2: Consult the law on tax calculation
guidePage.step3Desc: Complete the declaration form with all required information.
guidePage.step3Action1: Scan and upload the manually filled form - the AI will automatically complete the fields
guidePage.step3Action2: Manually fill out the form on the platform
guidePage.step4Desc: Submit your declaration to the competent tax authority.
guidePage.step4Tip1: Keep a copy of your declaration
guidePage.step4Tip2: Note the date and submission number
guidePage.step4Action1: Use the platform and submit digitally with all attached documents
guidePage.step4Action2: Submit manually to the relevant services
guidePage.step5Desc: Keep all documents for at least 5 years in case of audit.
guidePage.step5Tip2: Store them in a safe place

guidePage.faqDesc: Answers to the most common questions about taxes
guidePage.faq1Question: When should I file my tax return?
guidePage.faq1Answer: Annual returns must generally be submitted before March 31 of the following year. Quarterly returns may be required for certain taxes.
guidePage.faq2Question: How can I pay my taxes?
guidePage.faq2Answer: Payments can be made at authorized bank branches or directly with the tax administration.
guidePage.faq3Question: What if I can't pay on time?
guidePage.faq3Answer: Contact the tax administration to discuss a payment plan. Penalties may apply for late payment.
guidePage.faq4Answer: Keep all tax documents (declarations, receipts, invoices) for at least 5 years.
guidePage.faq5Question: How can I get a tax certificate?
guidePage.faq5Answer: Tax certificates can be obtained from the tax administration with an official request and payment of corresponding fees.
guidePage.faq6Question: Who can help me with my declaration?
guidePage.faq6Answer: You can use our AI Assistant or consult an authorized tax advisor for personalized assistance.
guidePage.needMoreHelpDesc: Our AI assistant can answer your questions about taxes and tax procedures.
